description: Defines the electrical-grid capacity rules used to determine whether a technology pathway can be supported by the available electrical infrastructure at an industrial site.

available_grid_capacity.description: Maximum electrical capacity that can be made available to the factory from the existing grid connection or verified electrical infrastructure.

existing_electrical_load.description: Existing peak electrical demand of the factory before the proposed technology is added.

technology_required_power.description: Additional electrical power required by the proposed technology at the relevant operating condition.

additional_grid_capacity.description: Additional electrical capacity that can be obtained through a verified grid-connection upgrade or other approved electrical-infrastructure expansion.

capacity_upgrade_rule.note: A grid upgrade requirement should not automatically reject a technology. The optimizer may evaluate the upgrade as an additional project cost and feasibility condition if verified upgrade information is available.

technology_requirement_policy.policy: Do not assign a universal electrical-power requirement to a technology when electrical demand depends on technology capacity, process load, operating conditions, configuration or vendor design.
technology_requirement_policy.required_data_source: Use technology-specific electrical demand from the relevant technology dataset, project input or verified engineering/vendor data.
technology_requirement_policy.capacity_scaling: Where technology power depends on installed capacity, calculate required electrical power from the selected technology configuration rather than using a fixed universal value.

missing_data.reason: Grid feasibility cannot be established when available grid capacity or technology electrical demand is missing.
missing_data.upgrade_data_behavior: If additional_grid_capacity_kw is unavailable, treat it as 0 unless a verified grid-upgrade value is supplied.

decision.grid_feasible: The available electrical capacity is sufficient to support the existing load and the additional electrical demand of the proposed technology.
decision.grid_upgrade_required: The proposed technology exceeds the currently available electrical capacity but may become feasible if a verified grid-capacity upgrade is available.
decision.grid_infeasible: The required electrical capacity exceeds the available capacity and no sufficient verified additional capacity is available.

scope_boundaries.electricity_tariff: Not evaluated by this constraint. Electricity price is handled by the electricity tariff dataset and economic calculations.
scope_boundaries.grid_emissions: Not evaluated by this constraint. Electricity-related emissions are handled by grid emission factors.
scope_boundaries.location: Not evaluated by this constraint. District and geographic information are handled by location datasets.
scope_boundaries.technology_temperature: Not evaluated by this constraint. Process-temperature compatibility is handled by the temperature constraint.
scope_boundaries.fuel_compatibility: Not evaluated by this constraint. Fuel compatibility is handled by the fuel constraint.
